name: Axiom Systems White Noise Bubble Generator WNB-1
product_name: Axiom Systems White Noise Bubble Generator WNB-1
description: A portable device that generates a precise white noise field in a 3-meter hemisphere, making audio recording and eavesdropping impossible within the zone. The WNB-1 uses adaptive noise generation — it samples ambient sound in real-time and generates complementary frequencies that render speech unintelligible to any recording device or listener outside the hemisphere. Conversation within the zone is clear and normal; conversation recorded within the zone is pure static. The device is standard equipment for corporate negotiation teams, legal consultations, and anyone who needs a private conversation in a world where every surface might contain a microphone.
story_hooks: A WNB-1 was found to have a firmware vulnerability that allows the noise generation to be inverted — instead of blocking recording, it enhances audio capture, turning the privacy device into a surveillance amplifier.

A modified WNB-1 has been developed that generates not just white noise but specific spoken words within the recording band — anyone listening hears a different conversation than the one actually happening.

physical_description.finish: Matte metallic with subtle iridescent oil-slick sheen; micro-texture grip surface around perimeter
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with silver accent ring around top edge; minimal branding in near-white
physical_description.interface_elements: Single large central activation button (matte black, slightly recessed); thin LED status ring (cyan when active, amber when charging); three micro indicator dots along bottom edge (power level, field integrity, thermal status); USB-C port concealed under magnetic access panel
distinctive_features: Faint concentric circle pattern etched into top surface — aesthetic and acoustic design element
Soft cyan LED glow emanating from internal matrix when active, visible through translucent edge gaps
Barely audible subsonic harmonic vibration when operating — felt more than heard
Micro heat dissipation vents arranged in geometric pattern along sides
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: AXIOM SYSTEMS logo (interlocking A and S) embossed on top; tiny regulatory stamps (GLMZ certified, CE-equivalent markings); serial number on bottom; warranty hologram near port access
